cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_DeployNode` 在 nodeIp/mgmtIp 搜索 `bba98a99` → 关联 `SYS_DeployInstance` → `SYS_DeployComponent` → `SYS_Service` → `SYS_CloudService` 获取云服务名
cases.sql: SELECT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.mgmtIp AS node_ip, SYS_CloudService.name AS cloud_service_name FROM SYS_DeployNode INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployNode.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId = SYS_DeployComponent.id INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId = SYS_Service.id INNER JOIN SYS_CloudService ON SYS_Service.cloudServiceId = SYS_CloudService.id

cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_CLUSTER WHERE name=kvm_group1` → `M_ClusterContainsPhyHost` 关联 `CLOUD_HOST` → 按 hostId 关联 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA` 分组，返回宿主机-VM对应表
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId

cases.question: kvm_group1集群下有多少台宿主机，每台宿主机上跑了多少虚拟机
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA` 按 `clusterName=kvm_group1` 过滤 → 按 `hostId` 分组统计各宿主机VM数 → `CLOUD_HOST` 获取宿主机信息
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress, COUNT(CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS vm_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id GROUP BY CLOUD_HOST.name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress

cases.question: 查询ECScse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1的完整归属链（VM→宿主机→物理机）

cases.question: 查询ECScse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1跑在哪台宿主机上
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE name=cse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1` 获取 hostId → `CLOUD_HOST WHERE id=hostId`，返回宿主机 name、ipAddress
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS host_ip FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId = CLOUD_HOST.id

cases.question: 查询ECScse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1属于哪个集群、哪个可用区

cases.question: 查询宿主机kvm-10关联的物理服务器CPU架构

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4可用区az0.dc0中各集群的宿主机数量、vCPU总量和运行中虚拟机数量
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_CLUSTER WHERE logicalRegionName AND azoneName` → `M_ClusterContainsPhyHost` 关联 `CLOUD_HOST` COUNT + `SUM(totalVcpuCores)` → 关联 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE status=ACTIVE` COUNT，按 clusterName 分组
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_HOST.id) AS host_count, SUM(CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores) AS total_vcpu, SUM(CASE WHEN CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_vm_count FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY CLOUD_CLUSTER.name

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4可用区az0.dc0中集群kvm_group1下宿主机、VM及挂载云硬盘的端到端拓扑
cases.query_method: `SYS_BusinessRegion(name)` → `CLOUD_AZONE(name)` → `CLOUD_CLUSTER(name)` → `M_ClusterContainsPhyHost` → `CLOUD_HOST` → `CLOUD_VM_NOVA(hostId)` → `R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM` → `CLOUD_VOLUME`，返回端到端拓扑
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS host_ip, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.status AS vm_status, CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS volume_size FROM CLOUD_CLUSTER INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_CLUSTER.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_HOST ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id = CLOUD_HOST.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下KVM虚拟化类型的集群有多少个，包含多少台宿主机
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE logicalRegionName AND hypervisorType=KVM` COUNT；关联 `CLOUD_CLUSTER` 获取集群数 COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_CLUSTER.id) AS cluster_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_HOST.id) AS host_count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_HOST.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_CLUSTER ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id = CLOUD_CLUSTER.id

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的ECS实例数量、云硬盘数量和云硬盘总容量

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下内存剩余量最大的前3台宿主机
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE azoneName=az0.dc0` 计算 totalVmemoryMB-allocatedVmemoryMB 降序取 TOP3，返回 name、ipAddress、剩余内存
cases.sql: SELECT name, ipAddress, totalVmemoryMB, allocatedVmemoryMB, totalVmemoryMB - allocatedVmemoryMB AS remaining_memory FROM CLOUD_HOST ORDER BY remaining_memory DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4可用区az0.dc0中所有宿主机的主机名、IP、vCPU总量、已分配vCPU和CPU架构
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE logicalRegionName AND azoneName` → `SYS_X86Server(serverId)` 取 cpuArch，返回主机信息
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores AS total_vcpu, CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores AS allocated_vcpu, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id

cases.question: 查询宿主机9EAE8CF9-63F0-D196-EE11-C7830A72D98C的IP和资源配置，上面跑了多少虚拟机
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE nativeId=9EAE8CF9-63F0-D196-EE11-C7830A72D98C` 返回 ipAddress、totalCpu → `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE hostId` COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.totalCpu AS total_cpu, COUNT(CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS vm_count FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId GROUP BY CLOUD_HOST.name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress, CLOUD_HOST.totalCpu

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4可用区az0.dc0中所有宿主机的主机名、IP、vCPU总量、已分配vCPU、CPU架构和运行中虚拟机列表
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE logicalRegionName AND azoneName` → `SYS_X86Server` 取 cpuArch → `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE hostId AND status=ACTIVE` 获取VM列表
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores AS total_vcpu, CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores AS allocated_vcpu, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN SYS_X86Server ON CLOUD_HOST.serverId = SYS_X86Server.id INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON CLOUD_HOST.id = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.hostId

cases.question: 查询部署节点APIGWLB-01_roma-guian-4的管理IP信息
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_DeployNode WHERE indexName=APIGWLB-01_roma-guian-4` → `SYS_DeployNodeIP(nodeId)` 获取 nodeIp/netMask → `SYS_DeployNodeFloatIP(nodeId)` 获取 floatIp
cases.sql: SELECT name AS node_name, mgmtIp AS mgmt_ip FROM SYS_DeployNode

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的管理虚拟机名称、IP和所属云服务
cases.query_method: 查管理VM（`CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE management=True AND logicalRegionName`）→ 通过 `SYS_DeployNode(vmId)` → `SYS_DeployInstance` → `SYS_DeployComponent` → `SYS_Service` → `SYS_CloudService` 关联获取云服务名，按 vdcName 分组
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.vdcName AS vdc_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.privateIps AS private_ips, SYS_CloudService.indexName AS cloud_service_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = SYS_DeployNode.vmId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployNode.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId = SYS_DeployComponent.id INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId = SYS_Service.id INNER JOIN SYS_CloudService ON SYS_Service.cloudServiceId = SYS_CloudService.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VM_NOVA.vdcName

cases.question: 查询型号为Atlas 800T A2的服务器数量及分布情况
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_X86Server WHERE productName=Atlas 800T A2`，按 `logicalRegionName` 分组统计分布
cases.sql: SELECT logicalRegionName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY logicalRegionName

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各厂商的物理服务器数量分布
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_X86Server WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `manufacturer` 分组 COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY manufacturer

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各集群中vCPU分配率超过80%的宿主机列表
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_HOST WHERE logicalRegionName` → 关联 `CLOUD_CLUSTER` 获取 clusterName → 筛选 allocatedVcpuCores/totalVcpuCores > 0.8 → 按 clusterName 分组返回宿主机 name、ipAddress
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_CLUSTER.name AS cluster_name, CLOUD_HOST.name AS host_name, CLOUD_HOST.ipAddress AS ip_address, CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores, CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores, CAST(CLOUD_HOST.allocatedVcpuCores AS FLOAT) / CLOUD_HOST.totalVcpuCores AS allocation_rate FROM CLOUD_HOST INNER JOIN M_ClusterContainsPhyHost ON CLOUD_HOST.id = M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.target_Instance_Id INNER JOIN CLOUD_CLUSTER ON M_ClusterContainsPhyHost.source_Instance_Id = CLOUD_CLUSTER.id

cases.question: 资产状态为报废的设备有多少台，分别属于哪些类别
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_Device WHERE assetStatus=报废`，按 `class_Name` 分组 COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT class_Name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_Device GROUP BY class_Name

cases.question: 查询X86服务器的基本信息
cases.query_method: 查 SYS_X86Server → 返回 name, ipAddress, cpuArch, cpuCores
cases.sql: SELECT SYS_X86Server.hostName AS name, SYS_X86Server.hostIpAddress AS ip_address, SYS_X86Server.cpuArch AS cpu_arch, SYS_X86Server.cpuCores AS cpu_cores FROM SYS_X86Server

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各区域的物理服务器数量
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_X86Server WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `dcId` 分组 COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT logicalRegionName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SYS_X86Server GROUP BY logicalRegionName

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下物理设备按类型分布（服务器/交换机/存储设备）
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_Device WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `class_Name` 分组 COUNT（SYS_StorDevice/SYS_Switch/SYS_X86Server）

cases.question: 查询租户AdvanceService_System_VDC的ECS虚拟机列表
cases.query_method: 查 CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE vdcName=AdvanceService_System_VDC → 返回 name, status, nativeId

cases.question: 查询云服务ApiCom的微服务实例部署节点信息
cases.query_method: `SYS_CloudService(indexName=ApiCom)` → `SYS_Service WHERE cloudServiceId` → `SYS_DeployComponent WHERE serviceId` → `SYS_DeployInstance WHERE deployComponentId` → `SYS_DeployNode WHERE id=deployNodeId`，返回{微服务名, 实例版本, 节点IP, 节点类型}
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.id AS node_id, SYS_DeployNode.hostName AS host_name, SYS_DeployNode.mgmtIp AS mgmt_ip FROM SYS_CloudService INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_CloudService.id = SYS_Service.cloudServiceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_Service.id = SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployComponent.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId = SYS_DeployNode.id

cases.question: 云服务ApiCom的微服务部署在哪些节点上，节点类型是虚拟机还是物理机
cases.query_method: 同上穿透 → `SYS_DeployNode.hostClass` 返回 VM/PM
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SYS_DeployNode.name AS node_name, SYS_DeployNode.hostClass AS host_class FROM SYS_CloudService INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_CloudService.id = SYS_Service.cloudServiceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_Service.id = SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployComponent.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployNode ON SYS_DeployInstance.deployNodeId = SYS_DeployNode.id

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各云服务的微服务实例数量
cases.query_method: 查 `SYS_CloudService WHERE logicalRegionName` → `SYS_Service` → `SYS_DeployComponent` → `SYS_DeployInstance` COUNT，按 cloudServiceName 分组
cases.sql: SELECT SYS_CloudService.indexName AS cloud_service_name, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM SYS_CloudService INNER JOIN SYS_Service ON SYS_CloudService.id = SYS_Service.cloudServiceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployComponent ON SYS_Service.id = SYS_DeployComponent.serviceId INNER JOIN SYS_DeployInstance ON SYS_DeployComponent.id = SYS_DeployInstance.deployComponentId GROUP BY SYS_CloudService.indexName

cases.question: 帮我统计所有云硬盘按状态和类型的分布情况

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的云硬盘数量和总容量

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的云硬盘数量和总容量
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `tenantName` 分组 COUNT + `SUM(size)`
cases.sql: SELECT vdcName, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(size) AS total_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName

cases.question: 查询VDCAdvanceService_Manage_VDC在区域region_guian4中的云硬盘列表及容量
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE vdcName AND logicalRegionName`，返回 name、size、status、volumeTypeName
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status, 'N/A' AS type_name FROM CLOUD_VOLUME

cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE name=cse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1` 获取 ID → `R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM` 关联 `CLOUD_VOLUME`，返回{Volume名, 大小GB, 类型, bootable, 状态}
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size_gb, CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable AS bootable, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id

cases.question: ECScse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1挂载的云硬盘中哪些是系统盘，哪些是数据盘
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA(name=cse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1)` → `R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM` → `CLOUD_VOLUME` 按 `bootable` 字段 true/false 分组返回
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable AS bootable, CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VOLUME.bootable

cases.question: 帮我查询云硬盘functiongraph-manager-9oslr-volume-0000挂载到了哪台ECS实例
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE name=functiongraph-manager-9oslr-volume-0000` → `R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM` 获取关联VM列表，返回{Volume名, 大小, 状态, 挂载VM}
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size, CLOUD_VOLUME.status AS status, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name FROM CLOUD_VOLUME INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VOLUME.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VM_NOVA ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId = CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id

cases.question: 云硬盘functiongraph-manager-9oslr-volume-0000当前是否已挂载

cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.vdcName AS vdc_name, CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.name AS instance_name, 'N/A' AS pool_name FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE GROUP BY CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE.vdcName

cases.question: 查询ECScse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1挂载的云硬盘中容量最大的一个，返回名称和容量
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE name=cse-engine-cluster-roma-guian-4-3-master-1` → `R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM` → `CLOUD_VOLUME` 按 `size` 降序取 TOP1
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VOLUME.name AS volume_name, CLOUD_VOLUME.size AS size FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId INNER JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id ORDER BY CLOUD_VOLUME.size DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 帮我查询存储池cinder-kvm003@bussiness_storage02#0的容量使用情况
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL WHERE name=cinder-kvm003@bussiness_storage02#0`，计算使用率=(total-free)/total、超配比=provisioned/total
cases.sql: SELECT name, totalCapacityGB, freeCapacityGB, provisionedCapacityGB, (totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) AS used_capacity, ROUND((totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS usage_rate, ROUND(provisionedCapacityGB * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS over_subscription_ratio FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各可用区的存储池容量使用情况
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `azoneName` 分组 `SUM(totalCapacityGB)`/`SUM(freeCapacityGB)`，返回各可用区存储池容量和使用率
cases.sql: SELECT azoneName, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity, (SUM(totalCapacityGB) - SUM(freeCapacityGB)) AS used_capacity, ROUND((SUM(totalCapacityGB) - SUM(freeCapacityGB)) * 100.0 / SUM(totalCapacityGB), 2) AS usage_rate FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL GROUP BY azoneName

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下各存储池的已用容量和使用率，按使用率降序
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL WHERE azoneName=az0.dc0` 计算 (totalCapacityGB-freeCapacityGB)/totalCapacityGB 使用率，降序返回
cases.sql: SELECT name, totalCapacityGB, freeCapacityGB, (totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) AS used_capacity, ROUND((totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) * 100.0 / totalCapacityGB, 2) AS usage_rate FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL ORDER BY usage_rate DESC

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各可用区的存储池名称、磁盘类型、物理容量总量、已用量、可用量和超配比
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL WHERE logicalRegionName` 按 `azoneName`+diskType 分组返回 totalCapacity/usedCapacity/freeCapacity/超配比
cases.sql: SELECT azoneName, storageProtocol, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(totalCapacityGB - freeCapacityGB) AS used_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity, ROUND(SUM(provisionedCapacityGB) * 100.0 / SUM(totalCapacityGB), 2) AS over_subscription_ratio FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL GROUP BY azoneName, storageProtocol

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下OBS桶列表
cases.query_method: 查 `CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET WHERE logicalRegionName`，返回 name、bucketName、status

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的云硬盘平均容量和最大容量

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各厂商存储池的总容量和可用容量

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的GaussDB实例数量和总存储容量

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下ELB列表及监听器

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT CLOUD_ELB.name AS elb_name, CLOUD_ELB.id AS elb_id, CLOUD_LISTENER.name AS listener_name, CLOUD_LISTENER.protocol AS listener_protocol, CLOUD_LISTENER.port AS listener_port FROM CLOUD_ELB INNER JOIN CLOUD_LISTENER ON CLOUD_ELB.id = CLOUD_LISTENER.elbId

cases.question: 查询ELBcloudpipeline_backend_elb的监听器列表

cases.query_method: 级联：①CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE logicalRegionName 按flavorId分组COUNT降序取TOP1；②CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE flavorId 获取name/tenantName
cases.sql: SELECT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.name AS vm_name, CLOUD_VM_NOVA.tenantName AS tenant_name FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下云硬盘数量最多的租户，列出该租户的云硬盘名称和容量
cases.query_method: 级联：①CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE logicalRegionName 按tenantName分组COUNT降序取TOP1；②该租户 CLOUD_VOLUME 获取name/size
cases.sql: SELECT name AS volume_name, size AS volume_size, status AS volume_status FROM CLOUD_VOLUME

cases.question: 查询租户AdvanceService_System_VDC的ECS实例名和IP、云硬盘名称和容量、VPC名称列表
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE tenantName 返回 name/privateIps；②CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE tenantName 返回 name/size；③CLOUD_ROUTER WHERE tenantName 返回 name
cases.sql: SELECT name AS volume_name, size AS volume_size, status AS volume_status FROM CLOUD_VOLUME

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下ELB数量、监听器总数和后端服务器成员总数
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_ELB WHERE azoneName COUNT；②CLOUD_LISTENER COUNT；③CLOUD_ELB_POOL_MEMBERS COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS elb_count FROM CLOUD_ELB

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下物理设备总数、交换机数量和存储设备数量
cases.query_method: 并行：①SYS_Device WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT；②SYS_Switch WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT；③SYS_StorDevice WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM SYS_Device

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下存储池数量、总容量、已用容量和可用容量
cases.query_method: 并行：CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL WHERE azoneName COUNT + SUM(totalCapacityGB) + SUM(allocatedCapacityGB) + SUM(freeCapacityGB)
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pool_count, SUM(totalCapacityGB) AS total_capacity, SUM(allocatedCapacityGB) AS allocated_capacity, SUM(freeCapacityGB) AS free_capacity FROM CLOUD_STORAGE_POOL

cases.question: 查询租户AdvanceService_System_VDC在区域region_guian4中ECS的vCPU总核数、内存总量和云硬盘总容量
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE tenantName AND logicalRegionName → CLOUD_FLAVOR SUM(vcpuSize)；②同上 SUM(ramSize)；③CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE tenantName AND logicalRegionName SUM(size)
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(CLOUD_FLAVOR.vcpuSize) AS total_vcpu, SUM(CLOUD_FLAVOR.ramSize) AS total_ram FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA INNER JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id

cases.question: 查询VDCAdvanceService_Manage_VDC在区域region_guian4中各VPC的子网数量和弹性IP数量
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_ROUTER WHERE vdcName AND logicalRegionName 获取VPC列表；②各VPC → CLOUD_SUBNET COUNT；③各VPC → CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT name AS subnet_name FROM CLOUD_SUBNET

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下ELB列表、各ELB的监听器数量和后端服务器组成员数量
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_ELB WHERE azoneName 返回 name；②各ELB → CLOUD_LISTENER COUNT；③各ELB → CLOUD_ELB_POOL → CLOUD_ELB_POOL_MEMBERS COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT name AS elb_name, ip AS elb_ip, status FROM CLOUD_ELB

cases.question: 查询可用区az0.dc0下宿主机列表、每台宿主机的VM数量和VM状态分布
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_HOST WHERE azoneName 返回 name/ipAddress；②各host → CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE hostId COUNT；③各host → CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE hostId 按status分组
cases.sql: SELECT name AS host_name, ipAddress AS host_ip, status AS host_status FROM CLOUD_HOST

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下GaussDB实例数量、中间件实例数量和OBS桶数量
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT；②CLOUD_MIDDLEWARE WHERE logicalRegionId COUNT；③CLOUD_OBS_BUCKET WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gaussdb_count FROM CLOUD_GAUSSDB_INSTANCE

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下交换机数量、路由器数量和虚拟防火墙数量
cases.query_method: 并行：①SYS_Switch WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT；②SYS_Router WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT；③CLOUD_VFW WHERE logicalRegionName COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS switch_count FROM SYS_Switch

cases.question: 查询区域region_guian4下各VDC的ECS总vCPU核数、云硬盘总容量和GaussDB节点总数
cases.query_method: 并行：①CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE logicalRegionName → CLOUD_FLAVOR 按 vdcName 分组 SUM(vcpuSize)；②CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE logicalRegionName 按vdcName 分组 SUM(size)；③CLOUD_GAUSSDB_NODE WHERE logicalRegionName 按 vdcName 分组 COUNT
cases.sql: SELECT vdcName, SUM(size) AS total_volume_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY vdcName
